findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: events_floor_card, events_whats_on, events_speakers, city_sweeping, city_gis, city_calendar · Private data: events_speakers, biz_info, city_datasets, city_records · Public sink: events_list, events_whats_on · Destructive: city_calendar.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: events_floor_card, events_whats_on, events_speakers, city_sweeping, city_gis, city_calendar · Private data: events_speakers, biz_info, city_datasets, city_records · Public sink: events_list, events_whats_on · Destructive: city_calendar

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
